answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 8 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the fable bond on all of them and exposing each to the dune slash. Because the hollow audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Each impostor pays 7 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
